abs_constraint._comment: Absolute-position + heading (synthetic RTK / surface beacon + GNSS-compass) fusion into GLIM odometry. Position-only GPSFactor + yaw-only PriorFactor on the live pose key X(current), matched by timestamp to /rtk/pose. Requires odometry_estimation.init_T_world_imu pinning so the measurement is a direct world prior. VALIDATED: arrests catastrophic feature-poor GICP divergence (9480m->~1m on seed411_sparse_explore) with the ORIGINAL GLIM (no core mods). 'Full authority' = gate_dist=0 + huber_k=0: RTK is trusted strongly enough to overrule a diverging GICP. CAVEAT: gate/huber=0 gives NO protection against a genuinely bad RTK fix -- for hardware add a kinematic (RTK-to-RTK) plausibility gate before relying on this in production.
abs_constraint._comment_sigma: Use validated measurement covariance, with a 5 cm lower sigma bound. The supervisor checks source plausibility and publishes the accepted absolute_pose topic; one fix constrains at most one live pose key.
abs_constraint._comment_yaw: Absolute heading (GNSS-compass / dual-antenna). Adds a yaw-only PriorFactor on X(i), independent of the position gate, so a measured heading can correct a wrong frame yaw (the axis LiDAR-IMU observes worst). yaw_huber_k=0 => heading un-robustified so a trustworthy compass can bootstrap-correct a bad frame.
